name: Mrs. Grace Muthoni
bio: Mrs. Muthoni founded Gracious Love Academy in 2023 with 12 years of experience in early childhood and primary education. She trained at Kenyatta University and has taught in schools across Kiambu County. She is present in every classroom every day. Parents know they can call or message her directly with any concern, and she responds the same day.

name: Mr. John Kamau
bio: Mr. Kamau brings 8 years of experience teaching early years. He specialises in play-based learning and language development, using stories, songs, and hands-on activities to build confidence. He believes that the first years of school set the pattern for everything that follows, and he takes that seriously — every child in his class learns to read at their own pace.

name: Ms. Sarah Wanjiku
bio: Ms. Wanjiku focuses on literacy and numeracy foundations. She uses daily phonics, practical maths, and creative arts to keep learning engaging. Parents appreciate her detailed progress updates and caring approach. She is known for turning shy readers into confident ones, one lesson at a time.

name: Mr. David Njoroge
bio: Mr. Njoroge prepares older students for junior secondary with subject-specific teaching, leadership projects, and regular parent meetings. He helps children understand their learning style and build independence. His students leave Grade 6 knowing how to study, how to ask questions, and how to lead.
